@@ -0,0 +1,95 @@
+package ext
+
+import (
+	"encoding/json"
+	"fmt"
+	"strings"
+
+	"github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/ast"
+	"github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/rego"
+	"github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/topdown"
+	"github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/types"
+)
+
+const isAuthMethodName = "flipt.is_auth_method"
+
+var authMethods = map[string]int64{
+	"token":      1,
+	"oidc":       2,
+	"kubernetes": 3,
+	"k8s":        3,
+	"github":     4,
+	"jwt":        5,
+	"cloud":      6,
+}
+
+// IsAuthMethod registers the authentication method predicate for a Rego query.
+func IsAuthMethod() func(*rego.Rego) {
+	return rego.Function2(
+		&rego.Function{
+			Name: isAuthMethodName,
+			Decl: types.NewFunction(types.Args(types.A, types.S), types.B),
+		},
+		func(_ rego.BuiltinContext, input, key *ast.Term) (*ast.Term, error) {
+			return isAuthMethod(input, key)
+		},
+	)
+}
+
+func isAuthMethod(input, key *ast.Term) (*ast.Term, error) {
+	inputObject, ok := input.Value.(ast.Object)
+	if !ok {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("no authentication found")
+	}
+	authentication := inputObject.Get(ast.StringTerm("authentication"))
+	if authentication == nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("no authentication found")
+	}
+	authObject, ok := authentication.Value.(ast.Object)
+	if !ok {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("no authentication found")
+	}
+	method := authObject.Get(ast.StringTerm("method"))
+	if method == nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("no authentication found")
+	}
+
+	name, ok := key.Value.(ast.String)
+	if !ok {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported auth method: %v", key.Value)
+	}
+	expected, ok := authMethods[string(name)]
+	if !ok {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported auth method: %s", name)
+	}
+
+	actual, ok := method.Value.(ast.Number)
+	if ok {
+		return ast.BooleanTerm(actual.Compare(ast.NumberTerm(json.Number(fmt.Sprint(expected))).Value) == 0), nil
+	}
+	if actualString, ok := method.Value.(ast.String); ok {
+		return ast.BooleanTerm(string(actualString) == fmt.Sprintf("METHOD_%s", upperMethod(string(name)))), nil
+	}
+	return ast.BooleanTerm(false), nil
+}
+
+func upperMethod(name string) string {
+	if name == "k8s" {
+		return "KUBERNETES"
+	}
+	return strings.ToUpper(name)
+}
+
+func init() {
+	ast.RegisterBuiltin(&ast.Builtin{
+		Name: isAuthMethodName,
+		Decl: types.NewFunction(types.Args(types.A, types.S), types.B),
+	})
+	topdown.RegisterBuiltinFunc(isAuthMethodName, func(bctx topdown.BuiltinContext, operands []*ast.Term, iter func(*ast.Term) error) error {
+		result, err := isAuthMethod(operands[0], operands[1])
+		if err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		return iter(result)
+	})
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,62 @@
+package ext
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/ast"
+	"github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/rego"
+	"github.com/open-policy-agent/opa/types"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+)
+
+func TestIsAuthMethod(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, test := range []struct {
+		name   string
+		method string
+		code   int
+	}{
+		{"token", "token", 1},
+		{"oidc", "oidc", 2},
+		{"kubernetes", "kubernetes", 3},
+		{"k8s alias", "k8s", 3},
+		{"github", "github", 4},
+		{"jwt", "jwt", 5},
+		{"cloud", "cloud", 6},
+	} {
+		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			result, err := evaluateAuthMethod(t, map[string]any{"authentication": map[string]any{"method": test.code}}, test.method)
+			require.NoError(t, err)
+			require.Equal(t, true, result)
+		})
+	}
+
+	for _, method := range []string{"k8s", "kubernetes"} {
+		result, err := evaluateAuthMethod(t, map[string]any{"authentication": map[string]any{"method": 3}}, method)
+		require.NoError(t, err)
+		require.True(t, result)
+	}
+	result, err := evaluateAuthMethod(t, map[string]any{"authentication": map[string]any{"method": 1}}, "jwt")
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+	require.False(t, result)
+
+	_, err = evaluateAuthMethod(t, map[string]any{}, "token")
+	require.ErrorContains(t, err, "no authentication found")
+	_, err = evaluateAuthMethod(t, map[string]any{"authentication": map[string]any{"method": 1}}, "password")
+	require.ErrorContains(t, err, "unsupported auth method: password")
+}
+
+func evaluateAuthMethod(t *testing.T, input map[string]any, method string) (bool, error) {
+	t.Helper()
+	query, err := rego.New(
+		rego.Query(`flipt.is_auth_method(input, "`+method+`")`),
+		rego.Input(input),
+		rego.Function2(&rego.Function{Name: isAuthMethodName, Decl: types.NewFunction(types.Args(types.A, types.S), types.B)}, func(_ rego.BuiltinContext, inputTerm, methodTerm *ast.Term) (*ast.Term, error) {
+			return isAuthMethod(inputTerm, methodTerm)
+		}),
+	).Eval(context.Background())
+	if err != nil {
+		return false, err
+	}
+	return query[0].Expressions[0].Value.(bool), nil
+}
